metaDescription: Order custom 2 oz products in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for samples, giveaways, and travel-sized branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Custom 2 oz products are a smart choice for businesses that need portable, budget-friendly giveaways. These compact sizes work well for sample promotions, travel kits, or event handouts where every ounce counts. From lotions to sanitizers, the 2 oz format keeps your brand visible without weighing down recipients. Decorate with screen printing or labels for a polished look that fits in pockets or goodie bags.
